mentions.name: NoFlakers
mentions.description: A site for finding people who want to do the same specific activity 'in the moment', matching spontaneous plans either locally or online.
mentions.problem: The author is more spontaneous than their friends, making it hard to find people for in-the-moment activities.
mentions.audience: People who are spontaneous and want to find others to join them for a specific activity, locally or online
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I decided to make a more “in the moment”  site to find people wanting to do the same specific activity, locally or online.

https://noflakers.com
